title: Train a tanh network on two spirals
summary: Train a 2-24-24-1 tanh network with mini-batch Adam until it separates two noisy spirals with 95 percent held-out accuracy.

mutants.missing_tanh_derivative: Forgets the factor 1 - h1 ** 2 when it sends the gradient back through the first tanh layer.
mutants.gradient_sign: Uses t - p as the output gradient, so Adam climbs the loss instead of descending it.
mutants.global_rng_shuffle: Shuffles with np.random.permutation and not with the rng argument, so two runs with one seed differ.
mutants.adam_no_sqrt: Divides by v_hat and not by its square root, so the Adam step has the wrong scale.
mutants.shuffles_caller_arrays: Shuffles X and y in place at the start, so the caller's arrays change.
mutants.over_budget: Trains for 2500 steps, more than the budget of 1500.
